The final order5 decorative title is below the routes, improving the earlier title crossing. Compact right-side captions and multiple curve crossings remain matters for original-size aesthetic review.
visualAssessment.drag: Devices and silhouettes are larger and distinct in the reviewed3-item and4-item phone captures; the2-item and4-item orders were included in the full phone/wide runs. Input geometry was not moved to obtain the appearance.
visualAssessment.results: Golden badge, larger score/stars and character give a clearer hierarchy. One-star100point result is retained as real data; final summaries use actual aggregate x/y stars and both real buttons.
visualAssessment.homeAndLetterbox: Workshop and character composition remain coherent. SHOW_ALL mint margins remain obvious in wide view; no native backdrop extension or dynamic rotation support is inferred.
